# Spar 0.7.2

**Spar 0.7.2 shows how a solved LeetCode problem compares: where your
runtime and memory landed among everyone else's in your language, other
people's accepted code from any point on that spread, and the problem's
community write-ups with the people who wrote them. The complexity check
now breaks a bound down line by line instead of in a paragraph.**

## After a LeetCode solve

- **A ring beside Problem and Chat.** Once a LeetCode problem is accepted, a
  small ring appears next to the view switch, filled to how much of LeetCode
  your run was faster than. Hover it for the number; click it to open the
  rest.
- **Where it landed.** Runtime and memory each get a column of dots per speed
  that accepted runs came in at, as tall as the share that landed there. Your
  column is the green one. Point at any column to read it out.
- **Read someone else's code from any column.** Clicking a column opens an
  accepted solution from that speed, with arrows to step through others from
  the same place, the same way LeetCode's histogram works.
- **How others wrote it.** The problem's community solutions, filtered to your
  language by default and sorted by popular, top or newest. Each shows who
  wrote it and how many found it useful. Opening one shows the full write-up,
  with code that has several languages gathered into tabs opened on yours.
- **Past challenges too.** The ring shows on any solved LeetCode challenge,
  including earlier ones in a session. If Spar has no accepted submission for
  it, your LeetCode history is checked, so a problem you solved on the site
  counts. It stays hidden while a challenge is being solved again as a review,
  and none of it is shown to the coach.

## Complexity check

- **A breakdown, not a paragraph.** The reviewed bound arrives as a short list
  of what the code does and what each part costs, for time and for space, with
  what each variable stands for underneath.
- **Your answer against the actual bound.** Under each growth curve, a miss
  shows your claim struck through beside the real bound; a match shows the
  bound with a tick. A badge at the top says which bounds need another look.
- While the review runs, the card shows what it is doing instead of a bare
  spinner, and keeps its shape so it doesn't jump when the answer lands.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.2-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.2.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.2-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.2-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.2-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- Community solutions come from leetcode.com only; leetcode.cn runs a
  different community board.
- LeetCode takes a few seconds after an accepted verdict to compute the
  runtime and memory spread. Spar asks again a few times before showing the
  numbers alone.
- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch, and those platforms may require a
  manual installer step for an update.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
